question: How is the one inert human thing settled amid seven and seven?
premises: By excess of the subject-share and upsurge of the object-share come seven and seven.
Yet it is one thing, merely inert, human-natured.
inference: The seven-and-seven reduce to one inert human nature, settled threefold per tattva with the next verse.
uncertainties: Correlative closed with the next verse.
plain_english: By excess of the subject-share, by upsurge of the object-share — seven and seven — yet one thing, merely inert, human-natured.
